name: Service health
description: Current overall health, open incidents, latency, last check, and service status.
template: <Stack gap="xs"><Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap"><Text fw={600} truncate>Service health</Text><RefreshButton requestId="health" /></Group>{status.health?.loading ? <Skeleton height={150} /> : status.health?.ok === false ? <Alert color="red" title="Service status unavailable">{status.health.statusText || status.health.error || "Request failed"}</Alert> : data.health == null ? <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">No health data available</Text> : <Stack gap="xs"><Group gap="xs" align="baseline" wrap="wrap"><Text fz={26} fw={700} c={({ operational: "green", degraded: "orange", outage: "red" })[data.health.status] ?? "gray"}>{({ operational: "Operational", degraded: "Degraded", outage: "Outage" })[data.health.status] ?? "Unknown"}</Text><Text size="sm" c="dimmed">overall status</Text></Group><SimpleGrid minColWidth={140} autoFlow="auto-fit" spacing="xs"><Stack gap={0}><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Open incidents</Text><Text fw={600}>{data.health.openIncidents?.toLocaleString("en-US", { maximumFractionDigits: 0 }) ?? "—"}</Text></Stack><Stack gap={0}><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Latency</Text><Text fw={600}>{data.health.latencyMs?.toLocaleString("en-US", { maximumFractionDigits: 0 }) ?? "—"} ms</Text></Stack></SimpleGrid><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Last check · UTC: {data.health.checkedAt ? Date.toLocaleString(data.health.checkedAt, "en-US", "UTC") : "—"}</Text><Stack gap="xs"><Text size="sm" fw={600}>Services</Text>{(data.health.services ?? []).length === 0 ? <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">No services reported</Text> : <Stack gap="xs">{(data.health.services ?? []).map(service => <Group key={service.id} justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap" gap="xs"><Text size="sm" truncate>{service.name ?? "Unknown"}</Text><Group gap="xs" wrap="nowrap"><Badge color={({ operational: "green", degraded: "orange", outage: "red" })[service.status] ?? "gray"}>{({ operational: "Operational", degraded: "Degraded", outage: "Outage" })[service.status] ?? "Unknown"}</Badge><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">{service.latencyMs?.toLocaleString("en-US", { maximumFractionDigits: 0 }) ?? "—"} ms</Text></Group></Group>)}</Stack>}</Stack></Stack>}</Stack>
